text: Board could use a per-person filter
Relative markdown links to repo files render as unsupported over Remote Control; do not link ids
Review ease of use — commands, markers and rules have accumulated fast; check a fresh cloner can still get going
Understand how two developers share one repo — WIP-1 is per person but board.md is one file, so collisions are routine and undesigned
Both starting the same task is the sharp case; a hook could refuse it, but only if `go` were committed and pushed the moment it ran
Two people distilling the same call transcript produces duplicate notes under different ids, and nothing notices
